description: Main CLI program setup for Playwright, including command definitions for testing, report generation, server management, and agent initialization.

methods.name: addTestCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'test' command with options and execution logic for running Playwright tests.

methods.name: addClearCacheCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'clear-cache' command to clear build and test caches.

methods.name: addDevServerCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'dev-server' command to start a development server.

methods.name: addTestServerCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'test-server' command to start a test server.

methods.name: addShowReportCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'show-report' command to display HTML reports.

methods.name: addMergeReportsCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'merge-reports' command to merge multiple blob reports into a single report.

methods.name: addTestMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'run-test-mcp-server' command to interact with the test runner over MCP.

methods.name: addInitAgentsCommand
methods.description: Defines the 'init-agents' command to initialize repository agents.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Executes the test run process with configuration, handling different modes like UI, watch, or full run.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts a test server with specified host and port.

methods.name: mergeReports
methods.description: Merges multiple report files into a single report, with configuration options.

methods.name: overridesFromOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration overrides based on CLI options.

methods.name: resolveReporterOption
methods.description: Resolves reporter string(s) into reporter descriptions.

methods.name: resolveShardOption
methods.description: Parses shard option string into shard configuration.

methods.name: resolveShardWeightsOption
methods.description: Parses environment variable for shard weights.

methods.name: resolveReporter
methods.description: Resolves reporter ID or path to a reporter implementation.
